scope: License and app-bundling review for local candidate audition files that are real-instrument candidates but not approved app audio.
policy_summary: CC BY-SA candidates may be commercially usable in principle, but they are not app assets until attribution, license-link, change notices, ShareAlike treatment, no-additional-restrictions review, and professional listening review are complete. Candidate files must remain outside GuoYueZhiPu/Resources/Audio/Instruments.

source_evidence.name: Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0 deed
source_evidence.evidence_summary: The deed allows sharing and adapting for commercial purposes, but requires attribution, license link, change indication, same-license distribution for adaptations, and no additional restrictions.

source_evidence.name: Wikimedia Commons file description pages
source_evidence.evidence_summary: Wikimedia file pages for the reviewed candidates state own work, author Francesc Fort, and CC BY-SA 4.0 licensing; each file page remains the canonical source URL.

global_requirements_before_bundle: In-app and support-page attribution must include title, author, source URL, license name, license URL, and change notice for any conversion/mastering.
If the candidate audio is remixed, transformed, normalized, trimmed, or otherwise adapted, release treatment for the adapted audio must satisfy CC BY-SA 4.0 ShareAlike before App Store submission.
No App Store DRM or app packaging choice may be used as a substitute for the required license and attribution notices.

Professional guoyue reviewer must confirm the instrument identity, timbre, phrase, articulation, recording quality, and suitability for the specific app entry; professional listening evidence must be recorded before approval.
The approved manifest must be updated through import_verified_audio.py; manual copying into the app bundle is prohibited.

items.author: Francesc Fort
items.review_notes: 嗩吶是最高風險音色之一；即使授權處理完成，也必須先由嗩吶/吹管專業者確認起音、裝飾音、泛音與音色真實度。

items.author: Francesc Fort
items.review_notes: 板胡與二胡、高胡、中胡差異明顯；必須確認不是泛用胡琴音色，也不能用文字標籤掩蓋音色不準。

items.author: Francesc Fort
items.review_notes: 琵琶候選長度較短，需確認是否足以代表單音、輪指或短句；Wikimedia 分類中同頁也出現 Zhongruan 分類，需專業聽辨確認樂器身分。

items.author: Francesc Fort
items.review_notes: 中阮候選可作為審聽素材；需確認共鳴、撥弦質感與音域是否符合中阮，不可與琵琶候選混用。
